title: Observatory Quest
start: Talk to the observatory professor in the observatory north of Castle Wars.

recommended.t: Antipoison potions (a super antipoison (1) can be found in the southeast building of the goblin camp) or a piece of augmented equipment with the Venomblood Invention perk.
An energy potion or any explorer's ring to boost run energy

rewards.t: Depending on the astrological sign you see through the telescope, you will receive one of these items:
An uncut sapphire (Aquarius, Aries, Cancer, Capricorn, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Scorpio, Taurus, Virgo, Pisces)
You can talk to Historian Minas at the Varrock Museum to receive 5 kudos.
Ability to use 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport after also completing Evil Dave's Big Day Out.

steps.t: Talk to the Observatory professor in the house near the Observatory which is located north of Castle Wars. [Chat: 1 Talk about the Observatory Quest. › 2 An Observatory? › Accept]
Obtain a bronze bar, 3 planks, and molten glass.
Talk to the professor three times (until he takes all of the above items). [Chat: 1 Talk about the Observatory Quest.]
Leave the house and go east to the abandoned buildings.
Climb down the stairs in the western building.
Open and then search specific chests for a goblin kitchen key.

sub.t: Be sure to finish the dialogue after searching to receive the key.

Every dead end will have a searchable chest. Head south (and slightly east) first and if the key is not found in the two chests directly south from the stairs, it is guaranteed to be in the far south-east chest in the dungeon.

steps.t: Go back to the staircase at the entrance, but do not exit the dungeon.
Go east, then north, and then head west until a guard is seen guarding a kitchen.
Kill him or lure him away from the kitchen.
Inspect the stove in the kitchen to receive lens mould.
Return to the surface and talk to the professor. [Chat: 1 Talk about the Observatory Quest.]
Use the lens mould on the molten glass.
Talk to the professor. [Chat: 1 Talk about the Observatory Quest.]
Go back to the abandoned building and climb down the stairs.
Head to the southern section and climb the stairs to the observatory, as indicated on the map.
Go upstairs. Look through the telescope and identify which constellation is seen (see table below).
Talk to the professor and tell him which constellation was seen. [Chat: 1 Talk about the Observatory Quest. › ?]
